literal_source_claim: A pointwise bounded family of operators is uniformly bounded.
canonical_claim: For an arbitrary family of continuous semilinear maps from a Banach space E into a normed space F, if at every x in E the norms of all values g_i(x) have a common real upper bound, then the operator norms of all g_i have a common real upper bound.
domain_and_universes: Universes uE, uF, uK, uK2, uI; arbitrary I : Type uI; E : Type uE and F : Type uF with seminormed additive commutative group structures; K : Type uK and K2 : Type uK2 with nontrivially normed field structures; NormedSpace K E and NormedSpace K2 F; sigma12 : K ->+* K2 with RingHomIsometric sigma12; CompleteSpace E.
quantifiers: all admissible E, F, k, k2, and scalar homomorphisms sigma12
all families g : iota -> E ->SL[sigma12] F
all x : E in the pointwise-boundedness premise
there exists a real bound C' valid for every family index
hypotheses: every g i is a continuous semilinear map
for every x, there exists C such that for every i, norm (g i x) <= C
conclusion: There exists C' such that for every i, norm (g i) <= C'.
